name: LiteLLM
description: An AI gateway and admin UI backed by Aiven PostgreSQL and Valkey. Bring your own model-provider credentials to serve an OpenAI-compatible API with virtual keys, budgets and usage tracking.

name: Metabase
description: Self-hosted Metabase Open Source with Aiven PostgreSQL for persistent application data. Explore the built-in Sample Database or connect your own data sources to build dashboards.

name: Streamlit
description: A generic Streamlit app with sample charts, filters, a searchable table and CSV export. Includes optional Aiven PostgreSQL connectivity to build on with your own data.

name: LangGraph application starter
description: A Python/FastAPI app using the open-source LangGraph library, with a draft-and-review workflow, browser UI and authenticated API. Aiven PostgreSQL saves workflow state; demo mode needs no model-provider key.

name: RAG and OpenSearch
description: A FastAPI service that chunks, embeds, and indexes uploaded text/PDF documents into Aiven for OpenSearch for RAG, with local dev support via OpenSearch and RustFS (S3-compatible storage) in docker-compose.

name: Langfuse
description: LLM observability with the Langfuse web UI and worker, Aiven PostgreSQL, ClickHouse and Valkey, plus an external S3-compatible bucket. A demo starter for fresh Langfuse v4 installations; tested with Cloudflare R2.

name: Temporal
description: Self-hosted Temporal Server, Web UI and an example worker, backed by Aiven PostgreSQL. A single-replica demo starter for durable workflows.

name: Hasura
description: Hasura GraphQL Engine Community Edition v2 and its native Console, backed by Aiven PostgreSQL. Expose tables through GraphQL queries, mutations and subscriptions.

name: FastAPI App with PG DB and Valkey Cache
Type text, find pictures, using CLIP, PostgreSQL® and pgvector
description: Uses the OpenAI CLIP model to generate embeddings for a pre-prepared selection of images, and stores them in PostgreSQL with pgvector. A web app lets the user enter a phrase, the CLIP model generates its embedding, and an SQL query is used to find the four images with the closest embedding to the text, which are shown to the user.

name: Inventory Demo - React and Go, PG and Valkey
description: A product inventory demo, showcasing multiple services communicating, with a Node.js web backend, a React frontend, a PostgreSQL database, a Valkey cache, a Valkey queue, and a Go-based background job service.

name: Apache Kafka® Streams: Anomaly Detection
description: A very basic anomaly detection example, using Apache Kafka® Streams. It checks for Apache Avro® messages containing a field outside specified minimum and maximum values, and copies them to the output topic. It's more specific for this than the general Kafka Streams examples. A program is provided to write an example data stream.

name: Apache Kafka® Streams
description: Examples of logging, copying and filtering (copying and altering) Apache Avro® messages, using Apache Kafka® streams and a schema registry.Kafka Streams is the standard library to use when taking data from one Kafka topic and writing an amended version to another, in real time. It is written in Java and kept up to date with Kafka itself.

name: Community Event Search
description: Searches and maps community events across Meetup and Luma, with filters for location, topic, and group size. Uses PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Runtime (fetch workers, sink process). Live at https://search.notanother.pizza.

name: BetterDB Monitor
description: A monitoring and observability layer for Valkey and Redis that persists slowlogs, command patterns, client activity and anomaly signals so you can debug what happened, not just what's happening now. Native Valkey 8.x support (COMMANDLOG, CLUSTER SLOT-STATS, per-thread I/O); Redis 6+ compatible.

name: Runs on Runtime
description: This directory site itself — a static site running python/nginx listing repos that run on Aiven Runtime.
